text:
There are **7 continents** under the most common convention:

1. Asia
2. Africa
3. North America
4. South America
5. Antarctica
6. Europe
7. Australia (Oceania)

That said, the count depends on the model you use:

| Model | Continents | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| 7-continent | Asia, Africa, N. America, S. America, Antarctica, Europe, Australia | Most common worldwide, standard in English-speaking countries |
| 6-continent (merged) | Eurasia counted as one | Taught in parts of Russia, Eastern Europe, Japan |
| 6-continent (merged) | North + South America as one "America" | Common in Latin America and parts of Europe |
| 5-continent | No Antarctica (uninhabited) | Used in the Olympic rings symbolism |
| 4-continent | Afro-Eurasia + Americas + Antarctica + Australia | Geological/regional grouping |

So: **7** is the standard answer, but the "right" number is really a convention rather than a fact about the planet.
